evidence.observation: O2 settled around 4-6 ppm after purge and through the ramp; 4.4 ppm at the start of growth
O2 climbed steadily during growth: 9.4, 14.6, 19.8, then 26.2 ppm (about +5-6 ppm every 120 s)
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by lost carrier flow
Temperature holding at 750 °C, heater power normal
No pressure gauge installed, so tube pressure can't be checked for the growth-stage atmosphere

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading or a manual leak/exhaust check: higher pressure would point to a blocked exhaust, normal or low pressure with rising O2 to a seal leak. Characterization of the sample.
